candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is not set. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees provider !== email and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
register does not pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email to usersService.create, so it relies on the wrong default.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
